parsed.name: 任意波形发生器
parsed.description: 任意波形发生器可输出用户定义的电压波形，并可通过查找表或码字索引快速调用不同脉冲。它常用于实验室中的脉冲激励、时序控制以及需要精确波形合成的测量系统。
parsed.description_en: An arbitrary waveform generator outputs user-defined voltage waveforms and can rapidly call up different pulses through lookup tables or codeword indexing. It is commonly used in laboratories for pulse excitation, timing control, and measurement systems that require precise waveform synthesis.

actions.description: 显示波形的功率谱密度图。
actions.description_en: Display the waveform power spectral density plot.

actions.description_en: Convert a time value to the corresponding sample index.
